items.title: How Much Should One Number Worry AppLovin Stock Holders?
items.summary: The number that should worry a holder of AppLovin (APP) stock is its revenue growth. Revenue rose 53% from a year earlier in the fiscal second quarter of 2026. That was the third quarter in a row of slower growth. The pace is still fast. But the stock is priced for growth to stay fast, which is why the slowdown matters.
